content:
Analyzing the datasheet: protocol support is “CPRI opt 10 / 25GE” with bit rates 24.33 / 25.78 Gbps; receiver footnote 2 ties -19.0 dBm (OMA) to 25.78 Gbps (25GE). Two models require separate modes per the rules.

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP28-ER-I 25GE",
      "model": "SO-SFP28-ER-I",
      "host_interface_name": "25GE",
      "standards_code": "25GBASE-ER",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 25.78,
      "rx_sensitivity_dbm": -19.0
    },
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP28-ER-I CPRI Option 10",
      "model": "SO-SFP28-ER-I",
      "host_interface_name": "CPRI opt 10",
      "standards_code": "CPRI Option 10",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 24.33,
      "rx_sensitivity_dbm": -21.0
    },
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP28-ER 25GE",
      "model": "SO-SFP28-ER",
      "host_interface_name": "25GE",

    }
  ]
}
```
